text:
alex: Heads up — Berkeley Health private deployment window set for Mon 2026-03-30 02:00-03:00 UTC (low-traffic). Need clear owners for: deploy, smoke checks, rollback, and customer comms. Can ppl ack and call dibs?

maria: I can own the deploy and post-deploy log sweep. I have the SSH access to the on-prem gateway and the deploy playbook.

sam: I'll take rollback + realtime health checks. I'll be oncall during the window. If things go sideways: gameplan is immediate canary rollback, then full rollback if canary fails.

jen: I'll handle infra preflight — pre-warm nodes, confirm NFS mounts and KMS access. I'll run the preflight script 30m before window.

deploy-bot: CI status: build/berk-private-image: PASSED
Images pushed: gcr.redwood/berk:2026.03.29-rc2

paul: I'll be the customer-facing contact and run the acceptance tests once canary is up. PTO note: I'll ping them 10m before start.

tina: Security check - VPC peering and KMS policies reviewed. No key rotation allowed during window. Confirming no pending ACL changes.

alex: Great. Deploy plan summary:
- 02:00: Set canary traffic to 5%
- 02:10: Run smoke tests
- 02:20: Increase to 25% if OK
- 02:35: Full cutover -> 100% if OK
- 02:50: Post-deploy checks + customer acceptance

maria: Deploy playbook snippet I'll run:
```
ansible-playbook -i inventory/berk hosts.yml --extra-vars "release=2026.03.29-rc2" --limit gateway
./scripts/set-canary --service berk-api --percent 5
```
I'll paste logs in #incidents if anything odd.

sam: Smoke checks I'll run once canary is live:
- curl -fsS https://berk-api.internal/health
- run ./scripts/load-smoke --qps 10 --duration 30s
- check 95th latency < 350ms and error rate < 0.5%

jen: Preflight checklist I'm running at 01:30 UTC:
- nodes present: gpu-01..gpu-04
- mount points: /data/models OK
- kube nodes Ready
- BGP/VPC route checks

tina: Also please confirm secrets access for the service account used by the deploy. Maria, can you confirm ARN used? If not we delay.

maria: Service account ARN is arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/berk-deploy. I verified kms decrypt in staging.

alex: Rollback command (sam to have ready):
```
/opt/redwood/bin/rollback --cluster berk-prod --service berk-api --to-image gcr.redwood/berk:2026.03.20-stable
./scripts/set-canary --service berk-api --percent 0
```
If canary shows >1% errors in 5m, execute rollback.

sam: Copy. I'll have the image ready and watch error-rate dashboards. Alerting rule pinned to my phone.

paul: I'll wait for 5% canary and run the customer acceptance suite. If they report anything, I'll escalate immediately.

jen: I'll monitor infra metrics and pre-create a support ticket template for NFS or mount issues.

deploy-bot: Reminder: maintenance-window label applied to CI runs; no automatic deploys will override manual steps.

alex: Ok all — ack if available. If no ack by EOD today we'll reschedule.

maria: ack :white_check_mark:

sam: ack :white_check_mark:

jen: ack :white_check_mark:

paul: ack :white_check_mark:

tina: ack :white_check_mark:

alex: Thanks team. I'll post a short reminder 1h before window and the deploy checklist in #eng-oncall.
